name: item_skill_object_pool

fields.+4: byte scratch / qty delta（init 不写；买卖路径作数量增量）
fields.+5: byte LEVEL（getValue 输入；本文件作者核对 0x49c070 各 cat 分支）
fields._no_def_index: THERE IS NO def-index / specific-name field in the main pool (all setters audited: 0x49bfc0=+8 word, 0x49bff0=+8 bit7, 0x49bfe0/0x49bfd0 write +0xb/+0xa = SECONDARY-pool 12B layout). 名物身份不在主池。

name_tables.getTypeName: 0x507ea8 stride7 -> idx=CAT(0..7) -> 8 类目名 酒/书籍/道具/财宝/武器/南蛮物/美术品/茶具（vtable[1]=0x49c010 live 反汇编）
name_tables.getShortName: 0x507ee0 stride5 -> idx=CAT(0..7) -> 8 类型短标（vtable[5]=0x49c1f0；非类目名，共享 item/skill vtable 的副用途：酒/药/信/道具/军…）
name_tables.getSecondaryName: 0x507a50 stride13 -> idx=副池slot(0..19) -> 20 具名特殊物（惠琼的信/介绍信/南蛮酒/铭酒/浊酒/药/绍喜·惠琼的墨迹/特殊宝物0014…0019）（vtable[6]=0x49c200）

category_mapping_27_to_8.note: 定义表 27 类(cat 0..26) 归并到主池 8 类(CAT 0..7)。数据驱动(189 件逐件核对，每 def-cat 唯一落入一 pool-cat)。二进制中无静态 27→8 查表（byte/word 均搜不到）→ 归并由 MSGX 脚本在创建物品时硬编码（续35：物品播种为脚本驱动，非 EXE 工厂）。

architecture.def_table: 189×19B SNDATA 主目录（名/类目/val/tier/flag/grp）是全部物品的总账。
architecture.main_pool: 0x51e1f0(200×10B, 扫描 0x51e1f8) 装「通用交易品」（金块/茶碗/刀…），身份=(CAT,LEVEL,SUB)，显示名=类目名，无 def-index。
architecture.secondary_pool: 0x517728(20×12B) 装 20 件「具名特殊物」（书信/特殊宝物0014-19），名=0x507a50[slot] 固定对应。
architecture.famous_items: 名物(村正/备前福耳…189 中绝大多数) 身份=定义表 idx(0..188)，存于角色/存档库存（另一结构，非本池）。⇒ 「def-idx↔池中实例」实例级绑定仅副池 20 件具名特殊物存在；主池通用品无 def-index。
architecture.doc_correction: 旧 §3.19.6 引「物品表↔物品池(0x517850/stride12)」中 0x517850 实为 **NPC/师父池**(stride12, 续21/27)，非物品池；物品副池是 0x517728。已更正。

registry_reuse.note: Same pool is scanned for skill-teach menus; bit7 + (cat!=7) filters. Skill display names come from skills_spec / MSGX, not 0x507ea8.

msgx_hints.teach_path: 0x442470 writes owner_key to +6 then rebuilds registry

slot_binding.owner_remap: 0x4a4115 — bulk rewrite owner si→dx when entity index changes
slot_binding.not_in_save_window: VA[0x5178dc,0x51c8dc); pool at 0x51e1f0 is +0x6914 past end

lifecycle.note: EXE has no scan-FFFF-then-fill factory. Empty slots are only skipped by scanners and written by free paths. Items are bound/transferred/activated (setOwned/setFlags/write +6), not allocated from free list.
lifecycle.high_value_picker: 0x456b90 — skip FFFF; collect sub>=0x50 then rand pick (NOT allocator)

findings: only bulk write @0x47a390 stamps vtable 0x4fc0e0 (no level/flags)
45× setFlags(0x49bfc0) never pairs with byte[+5] store; typical ecx=player/NPC/town
0x49c540/560/580 write +5 but on entity+0xe / 0x51661e — not pool objects
free paths only owner→FFFF; no category clear/seed
exe_seed_factory.residual: category/level must arrive via MSGX VM generic stores, alternate save mapping, or runtime blob not referenced by absolute 0x51e1f0
